notes.title: Patch v0.1.0.2
notes.content: [p]Here's the patch notes for v0.1.0.2:[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted number formatting so decimals now display with two decimal places.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved NPC navigation to prevent them from walking too close to buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where items could fall off intended surfaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new skyboxes and improved overall lighting quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where certain objects could remain floating in the air.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved cashier register movement for smoother interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where product photos could disappear after closing certain containers.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the market pricing algorithm for better balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the cashier drawer design to include four compartments.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled various textures for improved visual quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Applied minor performance optimizations for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please let us know when you encounter any issue on our Discord or Steam community so that we can fix it asap.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you and have fun![/h3]
